name: Sonoma County Human Services Department
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Sonoma County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs applications for Sonoma County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications — dedicated line (877) 699-6868
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children — dedicated line (707) 565-5500
- Adult and aging services, including IHSS
howToGetIt: Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call the main line. CalFresh and CalWORKs have their own numbers listed above if you know which one you need.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, benefits office, apply, Sonoma County, Santa Rosa, human services department
